evidence.location: The measurement section; Criteria table, LR3-C5 row
evidence.observation: The whole measurement is "`claude-sonnet-5-5` via the `claude` CLI, 46 calls, USD 0.29 of the USD 50 ceiling: recall 9/31 after the broad pass and 27/31 after the targeted pass; precision 9/10 and 18/23." evidence.location: D4; section 10 carried questions; H14
evidence.observation: D4 makes predicate agreement a required companion figure: "Participant names plus the section the fact was read from overlapping the gold passage, with predicate agreement reported beside it ... A produced fact has no span of its own (H8), only its section's, so the figures are comparable to #226's only at section grain, and the page says so." Section 10 carries into LR3's spec "whether precision counts a kept fact outside the gold passages as wrong, as #226 did", and the comparison baseline H14 is itself a predicate figure: "233 kept claims outside the gold passages; 3 of 29 aligned claims agree on the predicate". Because D4's match does not require predicate agreement, a recall numerator of 27 can include gold facts whose predicate the kept fact got wrong, which is exactly the loss #226 measured; without the companion figure the record cannot show that 27/31 and #226's "30 of 100" measure the same thing.

concerns.recommendation: Report the predicate-agreement count per pass beside recall in close-results.md, state the precision rule for kept facts outside the gold passages, and cite the `score.json` keys and the `docs/literature/index.md` line that carry both, so LR3-C5's claim that the page shows the scoring rule beside #226's figures is demonstrable from the record.
concerns.title: The reported recall and precision omit D4's predicate-agreement companion and the out-of-passage precision rule, so comparability with #226's figures is not shown

summary: Cross-checked close-results.md and close-delta.md against plan r4 plus its close amendments A1-A5, criterion by criterion (LR1-C1..LR3-C6), the goal predicates, R0.1-R0.6 and delta rows X1-X11. Arithmetic that holds: A2's 31 labels match LR3-C1's counts 11+8+12 and the recall denominators, and the per-pass precision numerators 9+18 equal the cumulative recall numerator 27, so the two ratios are reconcilable. Concerns are record-support gaps rather than contradictions: the Close row cites none of the guards, lint or component-index runs the plan's closure sentence requires and carries no verdict; the three unreviewed final repairs, the three-PR nothing-merged state and the two section-5 deliverables (release notes, extraction-contract citing line) are departures or omissions the delta claims to list exhaustively but does not; LR1-C3 is recorded as met with an unchecked-prose residual while the delta says no criterion was relaxed; and the measurement paragraph omits D4's predicate-agreement companion figure and R0.2's settings and labelled set, including the X6 budget raised to every source byte. This seat was instructed to review the inline artifact bytes only and to call no filesystem or shell tool, so no code, page, test or run record was read; every concern is framed as what these three records do and do not evidence, with code cited by path where the records name it.
